All-New 2027 Audi Q7 Becomes Virtually Sportier With a Lowered Stance and New Alloy Wheel Options
7 photos
Photo: kelsonik / Instagram
The US automotive market has noticed BMW’s leadership – the Bavarian automaker continued to hold on to the crown of luxury sales during the third quarter of 2026, well ahead of its pursuers.
BMW sold 100k units during the past quarter in America, with deliveries up by 3.4% and a year-to-date total of 287,154 vehicles. Meanwhile, the gap to Lexus has widened to more than 24k units, and Mercedes-Benz ranked third with 76,200 vehicles in the last quarter, up by four percent, while the year-to-date performance is actually down one percent.
What about the other Germans? Well, as it turns out, they’re going through disastrous times, as Volkswagen, Audi, and Porsche all fell through the US automotive sales charts during the past three months. Porsche, for example, could only do 16k units during the period, sliding by almost 13 percentage points, while Audi contracted 15% to less than 40k units.
That’s a shameful performance for Audi, as the year-to-date tally has reached a mere 107,667 units, down by 16% compared to the first nine months of last year. The Ingolstadt-based automaker has 15 active nameplates in the US market, but only six of them registered a positive performance during the past nine months.
There are signs of improvement, luckily, as the new A5 and A6 have risen gracefully by 21 and 24%, respectively, and there is even more room for improvement as Audi recently started deliveries of the third-generation Q7 mid-size crossover SUV. It’s still ramping up, most likely, so we’re not surprised that it’s down by four percent after nine months.
But most likely it will be massive boomer during 2027 alongside the all-new, first-ever Audi Q9 three-row full-size crossover SUV flagship, which hasn’t even hit the sales charts just yet. Knowing that, it’s no wonder that even the members of the imaginative guild of digital car content creators at time stop across the parallel universes of vehicular CGI to focus on the new Audi Q7 .
The third iteration of the mid-size CUV will fight the recently facelifted Mercedes-Benz GLE and the all-new BMW X5 Neue Klasse with a contemporary design that includes modern styling elements like the split headlights and the wider fender flares along with the rear LED bar. However, its biggest asset might be the evolutionary design, which makes it instantly recognizable as a Q7 and foregoes experiments like the Neue Klasse X5.
Anyway, Nikita Chuicko, the virtual artist better known as " kelsonik " on social media, thinks that now is the right CGI time to work on the new Audi Q7 crossover SUV and give it an aftermarket-inspired nip and tuck. The pixel master doesn’t make spectacular changes and instead lowers the suspension setup to go well with two types of new wheels – semi- or full-concave. All Users Can Now Download Android Auto 18.0 As "Cielo" Update Is Coming
7 photos
Photo: Bogdan Popa/autoevolution/Google
Android Auto 18.0 is here. Google has just promoted this update to the production stage, meaning that the rollout to devices that aren’t enrolled in the beta program is now underway.
While the version number suggests otherwise, this is a minor update. It doesn’t bring any front-facing changes, though it comes with more significant improvements under the hood. Google has been working on quite a lot of upgrades for Android Auto lately, and this new release provides an early look at some of them.
One of the most important is the Cielo update that users have been waiting for since the spring. Android Auto 18.0 includes the first reference to Cielo, and this could be a sign that the development of this update has reached the phase where features could start showing up for beta users. Android Auto 18.1 will certainly be an interesting release, though it’s too early to tell if Google is ready to enable any new goodies for beta testers.
How to download the update Before I delve into more details about this Cielo update, let me detail how you can download the update. Obviously, the most convenient and straightforward way is through the Google Play Store. If you enabled automatic app updates on your device, you will eventually receive the new version.
The only major shortcoming of this method is that Android Auto updates roll out in stages, and it could take a while once your device receives the new version. This can mean anything from a couple of days to several weeks, so the only option if you use this method is to wait.
Photo: Bogdan Popa/autoevolution On the other hand, you can download the new update manually using the APK installer. You can find the Android Auto 18.0 APK file on this page. Download it to your phone, and when the download is complete, tap the file to initiate the installation.
Depending on your phone brand and model, additional steps might be required, such as enabling permissions to install non-Google Play Store apps. Follow the on-screen wizard - it’s pretty straightforward and shouldn’t include more than a few steps - to complete the update.
Cielo and the new features The Cielo update is the biggest thing to happen in the Android Auto world since the debut of Coolwalk so many years ago.
Announced earlier this year , the new update is a mix of a layout redesign and new features that’ll use this layout.
Photo: Bogdan Popa/autoevolution For example, Google is getting ready to introduce widgets. Because Google doesn’t want to use the CarPlay approach - where widgets are displayed on a separate screen on the left of the CarPlay interface - it had to rethink the Android Auto UI to make room for widgets. This is why Android Auto widgets will be displayed side-by-side with the rest of the interface.
You will be able to enable widgets for your calendar app, weather app, and many other applications already installed on your phone. The long-term goal is to make Android Auto support all widgets already available on the mobile phone powering it, either with little modifications or no developer update at all.
This strategy would align with Google’s long-term goal of making the transition from Android to Android Auto as smooth as possible.
The other big part of the Cielo update is the expanded app support. Video apps are coming to Android Auto , meaning users will finally be able to watch their favorite clips and shows directly on the infotainment screen. This feature is already live on Android Automotive, where YouTube is supported, and Google is using a similar approach to enable it on Android Auto.
Photo: Bogdan Popa/autoevolution YouTube will pioneer the foray of video apps in the Android Auto space and will allow users to watch videos on the platform when they are parked. Google is developing an audio-only mode - which will also expand to Android Automotive eventually - to allow for uninterrupted playback when the car begins moving.
The experience would therefore allow users to transition from playing video when the car is stationary to listening to the audio track of the same video almost with no interruptions when the driver switches to drive. The purpose is obvious, as allowing video while the car is in motion would become a major distraction to the driver.
Google hasn’t offered a specific ETA as to when the Cielo update would go live, but originally, all these improvements were supposed to go live by the end of the year. This seems less likely at this point, so the Cielo update could be finalized and flagged as ready for production devices in the first quarter of 2027. We’ll probably be able to decrypt more details about the ETA in the coming Android Auto beta builds, where more evidence of this long-overdue overhaul will probably be hiding.
The full build number of today’s update is Android Auto 18.0.6642.

How Much Is a 2017 Chevy Camaro ZL1 Worth in 2026?
21 photos
Photo: Instagram | automotive_ambitions
The Chevrolet Camaro is bound to return to the automotive kingdom, probably for the 2029 model year, and until then, its predecessors will continue to make headlines.
In fact, they will still do that long after the future Camaro is out and about, because some models are on the extremely exciting side of things. You know, just like the one pictured above, which wants you to swipe right on it, after transferring the funds to the vendor and writing your name on the dotted line. Will you do that?
Well, it all depends on a number of things, like the asking price, which is the biggest one, as well as the overall condition, specification, mileage, model year, and so on. And according to the seller, this is a 2017 model year Chevrolet Camaro in the hot ZL1 configuration , which fought those pesky two-door Hellcats from Dodge back then.
This particular ride features a Summit White exterior paint finish, has a black cockpit, benefits from leather upholstery with quite a few suede inserts, has a premium sound system from Bose with nine speakers, a Performance Data and Video Recorder for more fun times at the local racetrack, and a few other bits and bobs that you can see in the photo gallery.
Photo: Instagram | automotive_ambitions On top of these, the Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 in question also sports a few modifications. The listing speaks about the new headers, X-pile, mufflers, a DSX tuning flex-fuel sensor, a Rotofab Big Gulp intake, and a 2.3-inch upper pulley. The muscle car in question has been tuned by RPM (Rains Precision Motorsports), and it is said to run from 91-octane to E40 fuel.
Thus, it definitely boasts more power, especially with the latter juice running through its veins, and if you are curious about the magic numbers, then you are not alone, as so are we. However, the vendor hasn’t said anything the output and thrust, so your guess is as good as ours when it comes to this aspect, as well as the revised 0-60 mph acceleration time, the standing quarter-mile performance, and the new top speed.
But even with no outside intervention, the Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 was very fast, and still is, even by today’s standards. The 0 to 60 mph (0 to 97 kph) acceleration took a little over three and a half seconds. The standing 1/4-mile was dealt with in less than 12 seconds. In fact, the official number is 11.4 seconds, with an exit speed of 127 mph (204 kph). And that’s definitely something to write home about, isn’t it? Flat-out, this model could do a dizzying 198 mph or 318 kph.
As for the firepower, it was supplied by a V8 engine. We are talking about a supercharged mill with a 6.2-liter displacement, which pumped out 650 horsepower with zero mods. That translates to 659 metric horsepower and 485 kilowatts. The thrust was officially rated at 650 pound-feet (881 Nm) of torque. That may be no match to the original Dodge Challenger SRT Hellcat, which had more oomph available via the loud pedal, but the performance was similar, in case you forgot.
Photo: Instagram | automotive_ambitions Now, what else must one know about this 2017 model year Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 in order to make up their mind of whether it is worth their hard-earned money or not? Well, the fact that it has a clean title, the vendor says, and at the time of cataloging, the odometer read in the region of 23,000 miles (~37,000 km). An image of the odo, shared in the photo gallery above, reveals that it read 23,437 miles (37,718 km), so it is a low-mileage example given that we are talking about a 2017 model year muscle car.
And if you are wondering how much one of these retails for these days, then you should prepare between $40,000 and $70,000 on average in today’s used car market in the United States of America. You could get one for a bit less than the former number, though it won’t exactly be a clean example, nor a low-mileage one. Some units can fetch close to the six-digit realm, but those are rare. Cars with under 10,000 to 30,000 miles (16,000-48,000 km) with clean accident histories usually go for $60,000 to over $75,000.
So, now you know how much a 2017 model year Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 is worth in today’s used car market on our shores. You also know that the pictured example has a clean title. The mileage, some of the equipment, and the engine have also been detailed, though keep in mind that this one features a few modifications. So, how much do you think you will have to cough out if you want to write your name on the dotted line and park it in your driveway?
That would be $59,991, which was the asking price at the time of writing. This muscle car is advertised on social media by @automotive_ambitions. Is it worth that kind of money in your opinion? View this post on Instagram A post shared by AUTOMOTIVE AMBITIONS (@automotive_ambitions)

2026 Cadillac Escalade Is the Jackal SUV Because Riding Sky-High Is Super Cool
11 photos
Photo: PaxPower | YouTube
Extra height, extra oomph, extra black, extra everything. This is what best describes this 2026 Cadillac Escalade that the owner heavily modified soon after taking delivery of it. Now, he is sure to get the extra attention he has been after.
The owner of this 2026 Cadillac Escalade took his luxury SUV straight to PaxPower Performance Trucks in Houston, Texas. He got it back a few weeks later looking and behaving like he wanted it to look and behave in the first place, now rocking nearly Escalade-V power.
Ben Norrell, co-owner and engineer at PaxPower, daily-drives a similarly modified Chevy Silverado and has been testing out the Cadillac Escalade for a while to make sure he is returning a reliable build back to its owner.
So the tuning experts equipped it with their Jackal SUV package. This means that they dropped the MagneRide 4.0, which used to handle the damping, and the Adaptive Air Suspension , which controlled the vehicle’s height, that it came with from the factory, along with the " cheapy shocks that were designed for grandma, " in favor of 2.5-inch coilovers from Icon Vehicle Dynamics. Bye-bye, bouncy suspension!
Photo: PaxPower | YouTube The new setup, paired with tubular control arms, raises the front end by approximately 3.0 inches and the rear by 1.5 inches and clears more space for beefier tires. The Escalade now rides on massive all-terrain 35-inch BFGoodrich rubber wrapped around 20-inch wheels.
Cadillac offers some of the biggest wheels fitted on production vehicles, measuring 24 inches, but that’s not the case for this SUV. The customer wanted an upgrade and switched the factory wheels with gloss black-finished Vossens, perfectly matching the Black Raven paint. Big red-painted brake calipers are visible from behind the black spokes.
The owner of the Escalade also asked for everything blacked out, so out went the silver badges and trims, but the story doesn't end here. The shop also blacked out the headlights, marker lights, and tinted the badge up front.
Running errands in it puts him in the spotlight, getting thumbs-up just about everywhere it goes. It towers over just about any vehicle out there except for semis. He even gets thumbs-up from teachers when he drops off his son at the elementary school. Football practice, meet-ups wth friends and family, the SUV is always the center of attention.
Photo: PaxPower | YouTube This Caddy is not all show and no go because PaxPower Performance Trucks also interfered with what is under the hood, where the 6.2-liter L87 V8 operates, producing 420 horsepower (426 metric horsepower) and 460 pound-feet (621 Newton meters).
They came up with a 3.0-liter Whipple unit, forcing 7.5 pounds of boost and taking the output with which it rolled off the production line to around 650 horsepower (659 metric horsepower) and 675 pound-feet (915 Newton meters) of torque. A Borla dual exhaust roars out all the drama of the V8 from under the hood.
That is nearly as much as the much power and way more torque than what the much more expensive Escalade-V comes with from the factory: 682 horsepower (691 metric horsepower) and 653 pound-feet (885 Newton meters) of torque. And just about enough to give the Ford F-150 Raptor R and Ram 1500 TRX a run for their money.
PaxPower backs the power with a three-year or 36,000-mile limited power warranty. The conversion is fully compatible with GM's entire lineup of full-size SUVs and trucks, which means the package goes perfectly with the Chevrolet Tahoe, Silverado, and Suburban, or the GMC Yukon or Sierra.

What a Barn Find: 1968 Mustang California Special Saved After 41 Years, Needs Restoration
41 photos
Photo: eBay seller kikiann727
Barn finds are the best finds, and this 1968 Ford Mustang California Special GT/CS is here to prove this to the world. The car spent the last 41 years locked in a barn, and despite this super-long tenure away from the road, it’s still in good shape.
The reason why it is here is pretty simple: the man who saved the car is now willing to let it go, so someone else can restore this fairly rare Mustang .
The GT/CS came to be at the San Jose plant only, and Ford produced only 4,118 units. The demand for this special model was impressive, but due to various production challenges, the output ended up quite limited. This is why the California Special is a highly desirable model these days, especially in collector circles where all-original models are particularly sought-after.
The California Special came with 1965 T-Bird taillights, fiberglass trunk lid, quarter extensions, side scoops, fog lights, a blacked-out front grille, and an exclusive coupe body style.
This specimen still appears to have all of these, so most likely, the owners locked the car in the barn and never turned it into a donor for other projects. This was undoubtedly the right choice, as the Mustang now appears to be complete and in good shape for restoration. It still has the fiberglass goodies, though I think that anyone interested in a purchase should call the seller and discuss how they can see the car in person.
This is a barn find that’s been sitting for over 4 days, so a live inspection should come in very handy. The engine under the hood isn’t the best, but it’s not the worst either. The GT/CS could be ordered with any engine in the lineup, but the buyer of this specimen picked a 289 V8 paired with an automatic transmission. The engine turns over, and the seller says they did not work on it, meaning that you’ll be the one who takes care of the rest.
The engine should still be in good shape, considering it turns over, but a good mechanic should be able to decrypt additional information quite easily.
The owner looks fully committed to letting this Mustang go, so they posted the car on eBay without a reserve. This means that the highest bidder is free to take the car home when the battle ends in 3 days and a few more hours. The top bid at the time of writing is $8,600, but the battle could soon get a lot fiercer, considering the vehicle ended up on the watchlist of no more, no less than 181 people.
Bidders often submit an offer at the very last minute, so be prepared for a difficult race to get your hands on this car. It’s parked in Webster, New York.

Update, Update, Update: Police Urge Kia and Hyundai Owners To Patch Their Cars
11 photos
Photo: Screenshot from YouTube video
Park smart. That’s the advice of the Nashville Police Department for Kia and Hyundai owners after dealing with a worrying increase in the number of thefts involving the two brands.
The reason is the same one that has been making the headlines for the last few years: the Kia Boys. The notorious group uses a vulnerability highlighted on TikTok where the lack of an immobilizer in certain Hyundai and Kia model years allows anyone to start the engine using only a USB cable - typically found in the car.
The viral video was posted in 2022, leading to a nationwide trend that put a crosshair on the back of every Kia and Hyundai parked outside. While the vulnerability only existed in some Kia and Hyundai models produced between 2011 and 2021, thieves sometimes attempted to steal other model years or vehicles fitted with a push-to-start.
Kia and Hyundai have already released software patches in 2022, but the Metro Nashville Police Department notification is another reminder that many owners ignored the call to update their cars.
The police claim that over 180 Hyundai or Kia vehicles have already been stolen this year alone, and the number of thieves involved in these attempts reached 250. It’s unclear how many of these people are members of the Kia Boys gang.
Photo: WTHR on YouTube/Alissa Smart The Kia Boys are a group made mainly of teenagers who steal cars for joyrides or to conduct other criminal activities. Most of them break into cars just to see if the method described online still works, while others record the thefts and post the videos online for Internet fame. The most experienced Kia Boys need only 25 seconds to get into a car and drive away , police previously said.
The method typically involves breaking a side window and ripping off the steering wheel column to reach the ignition. Kia has also released an ignition cylinder protector to prevent this exploit, and both carmakers are also giving away steering wheel locks for models not eligible for the software update.
The MNPD says customers should park smartly and lock their vehicles. But more importantly, they should patch their cars, as this security update prevents model years exposed to the famous Kia Challenge from being stolen with the TikTok method.
Photo: WTHR on YouTube/Alissa Smart Once installed, the engine won’t turn on unless the original key is used. To enable the additional security layers, vehicles must be locked with the key fob.
Kia and Hyundai owners can check if their vehicles are eligible for the software update on these two pages , where simply providing the VIN does the check. The software update is free of charge and can be performed at any Kia and Hyundai dealer. Just call the nearest dealership for additional information.
Hyundai and Kia have not provided any information about the number of vehicles that have already been patched. However, considering these repeated calls for patching cars, mainly coming for police departments across the United States, it’s obvious that many Kia and Hyundai cars are still exposed to the TikTok hack.
“It’s a trend that’s lingered the last few years & we need YOUR help to make it harder on those committing crimes in our city,” the Metro Nashville Police Department explained in a post. “Call your local dealership or check if your car requires the FREE recall online.”
Photo: WTHR on YouTube/Alissa Smart The Kia Boys can sometimes be as young as 12 , and many escape unpunished, being released by the police to their parents. More often than not, the Kia Boys are repeat offenders who attempt to steal more cars after they are released.
Police in multiple US regions have already recommended that Kia and Hyundai owners install additional anti-theft protections to block thieves, no matter if their cars have already been patched or not. In some rare cases, owners complained that their vehicles got stolen by the Kia Boys even after installing the software patch.
The main requirement for the software update to work is that the car is locked with the key fob, so it’s unclear if these people used this method after patching their vehicles.
Photo: Prince George’s County Police Department Steering wheel locks appear to be the most effective anti-theft hardware, as they could also play the role of deterrents, making the Kia Boys walk away when noticing them through the window. This means they could also help owners avoid hundreds of dollars caused by the Kia Boys who got inside the car by breaking a side glass or removing a door handle, even if they didn’t manage to steal their vehicles.
Alarm systems and GPS trackers can also come in handy. AirTags, Apple’s pill-shaped Bluetooth trackers that connect to nearby iPhones to broadcast their location, can aid in the recovery of a stolen vehicle, helping the police track it down before the Kia Boys total it.
In some cases, the Kia Boys set the cars they stole on fire or crashed them into other vehicles. Calling all Hyundai and Kia owners! Have you checked to see if your model requires an important anti-theft upgrade? It’s no fun having your vehicle broken into, but what’s worse is when your car is GONE. Please help us prevent that by PARKING SMART. Lock your vehicle, take your valuables with you (especially firearms), and get the necessary recall to stop these suspects from driving off with your car. Photo: jlord8 / Instagram
General Motors , or at least its Chevrolet division, is pretty sneaky, indeed. Do you know exactly what they were doing while all automotive eyes were on the upcoming novelties from the ongoing 2026 Paris Motor Show?
Well, as it turns out, Chevrolet was busy modifying the prices across the entire 2027 C8 Chevrolet Corvette lineup , and they quietly updated the online configurator to reflect a $300 MSRP hike across the range. Now, the cheapest 2027 Chevy Corvette, the Stingray Coupe, starts at $71,300, while the Grand Sport is $86,300, and so on, up until the ZR1X, which kicks off at $227,800.
America, though not only the US, clearly has a problem: inflation, tariffs, global unrest, and especially, above all, manufacturer greediness make new vehicles more expensive than ever. Chevrolet, as far as it is concerned, does have affordable options: the Trax and Trailblazer subcompact crossover SUVs kick off at less than $22k and $24k sans destination, indeed.
Even the all-electric Chevrolet Bolt isn’t overly expensive, at less than $28k, but you won’t find a new passenger car other than the two-seat Corvette in their lineup until the biggest automaker in Detroit puts its plan to bring back the Camaro into motion. Even then, don’t expect the new generation to come out as cheap as the current 2026 Ford Mustang EcoBoost, which starts from $33k sans destination.
Clearly, there’s a lot of space for Chevrolet to bring out a four-door sedan that’s affordable and modern, even though it doesn’t break the bank. If they don’t do it, no worries; the parallel universes of vehicular CGI have members of the imaginative guild of digital car content creators that will gladly do it for them.
For example, Jim, a virtual artist known as " jlord8 " on social media, loves messing around with all things CGI from the automotive realm, and he dreams of a reborn Chevy for his latest unofficial, hypothetical design project. More precisely, he wants to bring back to life the Chevrolet Corsica nameplate, a no-frills compact car that was produced for the 1986 through 1996 model years.
It was offered as a five-door hatchback and four-door sedan, along with the Chevrolet Beretta two-door coupe, selling as a companion nameplate to cover as many segments as possible. Now, the pixel master brings back the traditional four-door sedan body form with a simple yet contemporary style and a Corsica Z26 nameplate, the latter borrowed from the aforementioned Beretta.
So, what do you think, yay or nay for this potential revival of a no-frills Chevrolet sedan? By the way, the CGI expert has an entire series of such rebirths, which include a Ford Taurus SHO, the Mazda MX-6, various Buick T-Types, or the Ford Contour ST and the Lincoln Town Car, just to name a few – you can see them all in the gallery.
